name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Manager | SaaS Configuration, Data Migration, Training & Go-Live
summary: Implementation manager who turns documented requirements into working platform configuration and runs the project to go-live. Configures CRM and automation platforms from client requirements, prepares and validates data imports, tests workflows before launch, and trains the people who will use them. Managed up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and 25+ launches a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets, and built sequenced implementation plans for a CRM/PSA platform at Accelo, including walking clients through its invoicing and billing workflows. Uses AI and automation daily in delivery work, including rubric-based QA of AI output.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end implementations for client businesses: requirements, configuration, data setup, testing, training, and handoff, owning timelines and client actions throughout.
Translate documented business requirements into GoHighLevel and HubSpot configuration: pipelines, lifecycle stages, templates, and 20+ automated workflows.
Prepare, map, import, and validate customer datasets into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, re-checking every import and troubleshooting data issues to root cause.
Validate configured workflows end to end before go-live, and build integrations with webhooks, REST APIs, and JSON in Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Use AI daily on delivery work, from LLM API calls inside workflows to rubric-based QA of AI-generated output.
Document configuration decisions and changes in Notion so support and future changes start from an accurate record.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent across implementations to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded 15-20 reseller partners and ensured each partner's end customers were configured on Birdeye's listings-syndication solution, retaining all but one partner (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that helped partners roll the product out to their own customers.
Shared structured onboarding feedback with Product and Engineering; tracked all activity in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery; managed workflows in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Built and launched e-commerce sites for established retail businesses adding online storefronts, including third-party shipping integrations.
Ran onboarding calls as primary customer contact, launching simple builds on the first call and scoping multi-session production plans for complex ones.
Led and trained onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly sessions and 1:1 coaching, and defined the Salesforce fields used across onboarding workflows.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Walked professional-services clients through Accelo's invoicing and billing features, showing how time, projects, and billing connect in one system.
Guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, escalating account risk early; ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
